title: What's New: Product Information Management in Shopify Connector (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Item Variants and Attributes in Shopify Export
Item Attributes Configuration for Shopify Export
Custom Product Collections and Tax Override
Importing Products from Shopify to Business Central

features.name: Item Variant Image Export to Shopify
features.description: Item variants now have images that are exported to Shopify along with the product. Each variant can have its own image which displays on the online store.

features.name: Item Attributes for Shopify Options
features.description: Item attributes can now be configured to export as Shopify options. A new column appears in the item attributes setup page when Shopify connector is installed, allowing selection of which attributes to export as product options.
caveats: Only visible when Shopify connector is installed with stores connected
Not all attributes are exported, some are only added as description

features.name: Custom Product Collections
features.description: Items can be automatically assigned to Shopify collections based on Business Central item categories. Collections are configured in the Shopify shop card and rules determine which items are added to which collections during export.
caveats: Collections must be imported from Shopify first or manually configured

features.name: Tax Override via Collections
features.description: Items with reduced or non-standard tax rates can be added to specific Shopify collections configured as tax override to help Shopify apply correct taxation.

features.name: Add Item as Shopify Variant Function
features.description: A function to add individual Business Central items as variants of a parent item in Shopify. This allows a flat item list in Business Central to be presented as variants with options in Shopify.
caveats: Useful when Business Central has flat item structure but Shopify needs variants
Applies when item-specific fields are not available on variants

features.name: Variant Price Synchronization
features.description: Prices for individual items added as Shopify variants are synchronized, allowing different variants to have different prices based on their Business Central item records.

features.name: Product Image Synchronization from Shopify
features.description: When importing products from Shopify to Business Central, product images are synchronized to the newly created items.

features.name: Marketing Text Import from Shopify
features.description: When importing products from Shopify to Business Central, marketing text can now be synchronized to the newly created items. This requires a toggle to be enabled in the Shopify shop card settings.
caveats: Requires explicit toggle configuration in Shopify shop card
